tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because its implementation is cleaner. Related recorded decisions are that certificate verification stays enabled on all builds and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS backend, because its implementation is cleaner. It also notes the recorded rule that HTTPS is used everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.

The rustls decision is #14, and nothing later replaces it. It replaced an earlier decision, #12, which the file leaves out.

I left out the "verification on all builds" decision (#28). Its record doesn't say what is being verified, so I didn't want to guess that it means certificate verification.

The shell command I tried first failed with a parser error, so I wrote the file with the Write tool instead.

The Muninn hook heartbeat is also reporting red: 20 hook runs started and never finished. It didn't affect this task, but a hook may be exceeding its timeout, and `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` would show which.
